source_fit_rows.note: Same adult esophageal solid-food dysphagia symptom domain ('getting stuck' used verbatim, cohort ages up to 75 years), adapted from a predominantly younger eosinophilic esophagitis cohort (adult mean age 33.1 years, 'food getting stuck in the throat') to a 63-year-old adult with progressive retrosternal solid-meat dysphagia.
